'''Carl Mike Hardy Ralltiir Rampage''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site]] as '''Ralltiir Rampage'''. [[Carl Mike Hardy]] posted it in 1999.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Carl Mike Hardy]]
* '''Published:''' 1999 (Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Local Uprising / Liberation|SE-L-localuprising.gif|label=Local Uprising}}
* '''Strategy:''' Ralltiir Rampage


== Introduction ==

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

This is a veriation of the B&B deck that I have posted above. It's intent is to directly oppose Ralltiir Operations decks. It's also very effective against other ground decks... Provided they go to exterior locaitons. By starting with Ralltirr and the Farm, you'll be able to generate a decent amount of Force right off the bat. Try to get your oblective flipped as early as possible. Your vehicles will be extremely tough with Maneuver Flaps on the table... By deploying an ASP droid to a location, you can then swamp the site with loads of high power vehicles at minus 1 deploy. Incom Engineers add 2 to your battle destiny where you have a speeder. It's designed to strike fast and hard, and drain for a lot. However, be careful that your opponent doesn't hit you with a surprise Monnock... Deploy what you need to to keep your Monnock profile down. Also, be careful that your Manuever Flaps isn't Altered away... Manuever Flaps is KEY! If you feel you play in an area that uses a lot of S,A,C, adjust your deck accordingly... Maybe add another Manuever Flaps; Add some Controls; Anything to keep that card on the table. Without many rare card requirements, it's quite easy to build without a lot of money, either.
